notes: GAAP city. Governmental receipts/disbursements from Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p4), Total Governmental Funds column. Business-type from proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p6): receipts = operating revenues + lease income, gain on sale, interest income; disbursements = operating expenses + bond issuance costs + interest expense; transfers net and system development fees (capital contributions) in business_type. Business-type disbursement function 'utilities' used for all enterprise lines (water, sewer, golf, business park). Governmental other_financing = bond premium + original issue discount + subscription financing + sale of capital assets; debt_proceeds = issuance of debt. Governmental net transfers out 3,999,498 matches business-type net transfers in. ending_cash = total cash and cash equivalents (unrestricted + restricted) on governmental funds balance sheet (p3). Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total column (p1); deferred loss on refunding in deferred outflows; lease deferred inflows. Business-type has no noncapital financing section in the cash flow statement (null). Detail: budgetary-basis (cash) budget-to-actual schedules for General, ARPA, Keno Lottery, Papillion Landing and Papio Bay funds (pp8-12); these differ from GAAP statement amounts (reconciliation on p13); General Fund sale of capital assets 495,134 is printed inside budget-schedule revenues. No more detailed schedules exist for these funds, so no double counting. No business-type budget schedules in the trimmed PDF. Transfer cross-check: transfers in (GF 159,274, Debt Service 4,082,260, Capital Projects 969,580, Papillion Landing 450,000, Papio Bay 206,856) tie to transfers out (GF 1,298,323, Capital Projects 4,082,260, ARPA 4,034,158, Keno 452,727); no transfers hidden in spending lines. Pages 14-16 are statistical tables, not used. Read pages 1-16 of 16
